strings.p01-intro: Coastal geology × Forest ecology × Observatory lab
strings.p02-intro: A coastline, a spruce forest, a valley observatory — where the world in the textbook comes together.
strings.p03-title: Bringing the textbook world to life
strings.p03-text1: Horizon Camp sits where coastal cliffs meet alpine forest. Millennia of geological change shaped its tide pools and ridges; today it is also a key biodiversity station and dark-sky reserve.
strings.p03-text2: We designed the five days as one continuous line of inquiry: begin on the coast to read the rocks, walk into the forest to observe its ecology, then turn observations into data in the observatory lab. Every day has a question to solve, with a specialist mentor alongside.
strings.p03-quote: Children won’t bring back souvenirs — they’ll bring back a way of seeing the world.
strings.p04-intro: Geology, ecology, astronomy — every day has a question to solve.
strings.p05-intro: Each highlight is the core task of one day; students receive the matching workbook before departure.
strings.p05-card1-x: Explore tide pools and sea cliffs, and complete a rock-sampling survey with a field geologist.
strings.p05-card2-x: Learn how forest species thrive today and join a scientific observation at the reserve.
strings.p05-card3-x: Run mechanics and optics experiments with researchers at the valley observatory.
strings.p05-card4-x: Follow a guide into the spruce forest and record at least three local species.
strings.p05-card5-x: On the last night, present five days of discoveries to parents in two languages.
strings.p05-card6-x: One teacher for every eight students, a camp medic and 24-hour duty throughout.
strings.p06-item1-x: Geology detective task along the sea cliffs and pebble beach.
strings.p06-item2-x: Observe forest wildlife tracks and see how rangers track ecosystem health with data.
strings.p06-item3-x: Run the cart-and-ramp experiment and turn your measurements into your first chart.

strings.p13-sec1-x: One teacher for every eight students, each with at least three years of field-education experience.
strings.p13-sec2-x: Researchers from the observatory and nature reserve lead each day’s core sessions.
strings.p13-quote: We don’t find the answers for them — we help them ask better questions.
strings.p14-sec1-x: A camp medic travels with the group; the station is within 15 minutes of a partner hospital.
strings.p14-sec2-x: Every group carries radio and locator gear; mentors are on duty around the clock.
strings.p14-sec3-x: Everyone is covered by outdoor study insurance up to ¥500,000.
strings.p15-card1-t: What if my child’s English is weak?
strings.p15-card1-x: They can still join. Every session has a bilingual assistant; English is a bonus in the showcase.
strings.p15-card2-x: The camp kitchen offers balanced meals every day; allergies and diets can be registered in advance.
strings.p15-card3-x: Phones are kept safe during the day and handed out from 20:00 to 21:00 to call home.
strings.p15-card4-x: Yes, on written request from a parent, under the refund policy.
